local_changes: Replace serial saturating one/two-step binary/BCD decrement with direct constant-step arithmetic and parallel BCD borrow prefixes; preserve all counter/register timing and behavior.

Precompute binary and BCD one/two-step decrements between falling count-clock edges. Preserve visible counter/output cycles; inactive/reset candidates clear with count, and selection uses current BCD configuration.
Precompute scalar terminal-count flags and select period/output conditions in parallel with next-count data; retain current control/preset selection and original count/output cycles.

8254 read-back (2026-10-26, for pc386): the READ_BACK parameter (default 0, the 8253) adds the read-back control word (bits 7:6 = 11), per-counter count latch and status byte (OUT, null count, RW, mode, BCD); a latched status is read before the count. read_back.patch is the whole change; tests/test_fes_kf8253_read_back.py reverses it to the previous bytes and proves READ_BACK=0 sequentially equivalent to them.
